name: 05_backup_cfe
task: In 1C Configurator, make a backup file of the configuration extension 'api': export the extension to a .cfe file. Do not save or update the configuration itself.
rules: Do not change any objects. Do not delete anything. Do not choose any menu item with the words 'Обновить', 'Удалить', 'Загрузить'. Only exporting the extension to a file is allowed.

subgoals.goal: Click the main menu item 'Конфигурация' in the top menu bar (the menu bar reads: Файл, Правка, Текст, Конфигурация, Отладка, Администрирование ...). A dropdown will open.
subgoals.check: A dropdown menu of 'Конфигурация' is open (it contains items like 'Открыть конфигурацию', 'Расширения конфигурации').

subgoals.goal: In the open dropdown menu click the item 'Расширения конфигурации'.
subgoals.check: A window titled 'Расширения конфигурации' is open with a list that contains 'api'.

subgoals.goal: In the window 'Расширения конфигурации' select the row 'api' with a single click. The list can be long: if 'api' is not visible, scroll the table.
subgoals.check: In the window 'Расширения конфигурации' the row 'api' is selected (highlighted).

subgoals.goal: Save the selected extension 'api' to a file: click the menu button 'Конфигурация' in the toolbar of the window 'Расширения конфигурации' (it is next to 'Действия', with a small arrow), then click 'Сохранить в файл...'.
subgoals.check: A Windows file save dialog is open (field 'Имя файла', button 'Сохранить').
